title: Attachment storage service
interface: Exception AttachmentError(ValueError). class AttachmentService(repo: AttachmentRepository, audit: AuditRepository, directory: str, max_bytes: int, owner_exists: callable(owner_type, owner_id) -> bool). store(actor, owner_type, owner_id, kind, filename, mime_type, data: bytes) -> dict: owner_type in ATTACHMENT_OWNERS and owner_exists(...) else AttachmentError; kind in ATTACHMENT_KINDS; mime_type in ATTACHMENT_ALLOWED_TYPES; len(data) <= max_bytes and > 0; filename = os.path.basename(filename) stripped (empty -> 'soubor'); stored_name = f'{owner_type}-{owner_id}-{uuid4().hex}{ext}' where ext is the lower-cased extension of filename ('' if none); writes the bytes to directory/stored_name (directory created); repo.create; audit 'attachment.added' on entity owner_type/owner_id with details {filename, kind}. path_for(attachment_id) -> str absolute path (AttachmentError when unknown). delete(actor, attachment_id) -> bool: removes the file if present and the row; audit 'attachment.deleted'; False when unknown. Never catch generic Exception.

uses.config constants: src/config.py: ASSET_TYPES, ASSET_STATUSES, ASSET_CONDITIONS, TAG_COLORS, ATTACHMENT_KINDS, ATTACHMENT_OWNERS, ATTACHMENT_ALLOWED_TYPES, HANDOVER_KINDS, HANDOVER_STATUSES
